title: Non-negative Integers without Consecutive Ones
goal: Count nonnegative integers at most n whose binary digits never contain adjacent ones.
strategy: Precompute counts of valid suffixes by length. Scan the upper bound from its highest bit: whenever it has a one, replacing that bit with zero admits every valid suffix. Two consecutive ones end the remaining equal-prefix branch.
